_what: Every check run on this curation, with numbers. Each one has been made to fail on purpose and the seed asserts THAT CHECK'S OWN METRIC MOVES, not merely that something raised -- see 04_seed_results.json. Passing every printed statistic is necessary and not sufficient, so the checks that matter most here are the two the authors never printed: the mole percents summing to 100, and each library being a complete factorial.

OUTCOME.emit_rows_not_called_because: there is no row to flag. emit.emit_rows writes the quality columns of a corpus row; this curation produces none, so calling it would require inventing the row it is meant to qualify.
OUTCOME.blocker_1_values: No per-LNP delivery value exists in anything we hold or could obtain. The SI prints no delivery number on any of its 26 pages. The main-text figures hold them, and Figs 3B-G (and SI Fig S3j-uu) are UNLABELLED log-log scatters, so even with the figure in hand a digitised point carries no particle identity. Data availability is request-only; find_repo returned 0 repositories.
OUTCOME.blocker_2_structures: Not one of the 15 lipomers has a determinable SMILES. 7 of 15 are built on PEI 600 or PEI 1200 (polydisperse branched polymers -- no single molecule exists); for the other 8 the amine is defined but the degree of substitution is never stated, leaving the product open across 1 to 6 tails, i.e. a factor of ~6 in mass.

library_4_is_separate.note: the spleen screen (Fig 5/6, SI Fig S5a). Not part of the 281 and never pooled with it.

reconciliation_against_the_tracker.what_281_counts: LNP FORMULATIONS, not chemistries. The 281 are built from 15 distinct lipomers; 206 of the 564 formulated LNPs across all four libraries carry one single lipomer (7C1).

checks.why_this_one_matters: 24 columns of sparse single digits are exactly where a column shifted by one would hide. A shift would collide two values into one column and produce repeats; 0 repeats across 24 columns is strong evidence the assignment is right.

checks.why_this_one_matters: Another invariant the authors never printed. A missing, duplicated or mis-parsed design row breaks the product identity immediately; all four closing exactly is a strong statement that 564/564 rows were read correctly.

checks.what: block structures: formula implied by the chemical NAME vs the SMILES written for it
found_two_of_my_own_errors_before_it_pas: 1,2-epoxypentadecane first written one carbon too long (C16H32O against the C15H30O the name requires)
the azamacrocycle first written with its nitrogens off the 1,4,8,12 locants, at the correct ring size and the correct formula
checks.seeded: lengthen spermidine by one CH2 -> failures 0 -> 1 and exit code 0 -> 1; and move one macrocycle nitrogen to position 11, which leaves BOTH sides at C11H26N4 / 214.2157 Da (measured, not asserted) so only the ring walk can see it

checks.what: C10 anchor: blocks re-derived from the numbers in their own chemical names, by a route that shares no SMILES literal with the enumerator
checks.posture: Byte-identity of the emitted string is NOT the signal and C16 says so: a correct re-derivation is byte-identical to a correct enumeration once canonicalised, which is exactly why C10's own anchor_may_be_a_copy missed F-037. What differs here is the GENERATOR'S TEMPLATE -- make_reference.py composes each structure from segment lengths, ring locants and chain-length-minus-two, and copies no SMILES from stage05_blocks.py.
checks.anchor_for_the_ionizable_lipids: EMPTY on all 15 rows. The paper draws no complete lipomer anywhere; every scheme is a generic Markush with an unlabelled R and, for the PEI lipomers, the amine itself abstracted to diethylamine. The empty rows are stored so the absence is visible.

checks.what: the SI reaction scheme's colour key, measured rather than read
checks.result: PASS -- and it RETRACTS a contradiction I had raised
checks.note: Read in stacked order the key looks inverted (7C1 over 104 against R1 over R2). It is colour-keyed, not order-keyed, and the colours pair 104 with R1=C10 and 7C1 with R2=C13, which is chemically right. SI Fig S5a confirms it independently. See 08_contradictions.csv row 5.

printed_statistics_reproduced.caveat: Both are arithmetic on counts we also take from the paper, so they are weak evidence. The load-bearing checks here are B, I and H, which use quantities the authors never printed.

a_round_number_the_authors_drew_but_neve.what: the four mole percents of every formulation sum to exactly 100
a_round_number_the_authors_drew_but_neve.residual: exactly 0 on all 564; the sums are integers or one decimal and no row needed rounding
a_round_number_the_authors_drew_but_neve.why_it_is_the_right_kind_of_test: It is a constraint of the experimental design rather than a recomputed marginal, so it is external to our extraction in the way CLAUDE.md asks for, and it is what decides the one disagreement the paper has with itself.
a_round_number_the_authors_drew_but_neve.second_such_number: each of the four libraries is a complete factorial, closing exactly at 144, 120, 156 and 144

what_could_not_be_verified: Any delivery value. None is obtainable, so none was checked.

The main text's '309 relationships between LNP structure and in vivo delivery' (P14). SI Fig S4h is a stacked bar chart of significant/non-significant counts over 8 categories, with a printed axis to 100 and no printed totals; reading it would require pixels, and the curation uses none.

The stable counts 112, 105, 64 and 85 individually. Only their sum (281) and the derived 66.9%/33.1% are printed; the per-library figures come from the main text's prose and SI Fig S3e/g/S5b are diameter dot plots, not counts.
The degree of substitution of any lipomer. It is stated nowhere in the main text, the SI, or any scheme, and this is the second of the two blockers above.

Whether the Fig S4e/f/g in vitro ranks come from the 20 ng dose and the 72 h timepoint. Methods fixes 20 ng and 72 h for everything after the dose test, and the library panels are labelled '72 hours', but the Fig S4 panel itself states neither. 05_values.csv records this as 'not stated on the panel' rather than filling it in, and it is DECISION D-4.
